basic_details.job_title: Instrumentation Sr. Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline

application_fee.details: A non-refundable account payee Demand Draft drawn in favour of Instrumentation Limited, by any Scheduled Bank payable at Palakkad is to be enclosed along with the prescribed application. No other mode of payment is acceptable. Candidates are advised to write their name and address on the reverse side of the Demand Draft.

age_limit.details: Category Age Relaxation Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 Years Scheduled Caste/ Schedule Tribe 5 years Persons with Benchmark Disability (PWD) having minimum 40% disability 10 years Ex-servicemen As per government guidelines

qualification.details: Only Indian Nationals need apply. | Sr. Engineer (Commercial): Minimum 5 years of post qualification experience in preparing techno-commercial offer of control valve, butterfly valve, power cylinders and other products in Commercial Marketing of a control valve industry and requires interaction with customer for techno-commercial offer and should be well versed with MS Office application. Sr. Engineer (QC): Minimum 5 years in the field of carrying out customer inspection of control valve/ butterfly valve/ power cylinders etc and should have knowledge of the standards related to control valve and butterfly valves. Non Destructive Testing Minimum NDT Level-II in RT, UT, MPI & LPT in the control valve industry. Qualification is desirable and should be well versed with MS Office application. Sr. Engineer (F&A): Minimum 5 years of post qualification experience in the below functions of a reputed public limited company with preference to employees having relevant work experience in Central/State/ Public Sector Undertakings. 1) Data base management of finance and accounts department. 2) Knowledge of Programming in Fox-pro and oracles (ERP) system to facilitate generation of processes and reports as desired by Finance & accounts department. 3) Knowledge in processing IT-TDS returns (Form 16/16 A) and GST monthly/ annual return filing requirements.

salary_details.details: Candidates will be eligible for DA, HRA, PF and such other statutory benefits availed by regular employees as applicable for the grade. An annual increment as per the scale during the tenure shall be admissible on the Basic Pay, subject to satisfactory performance.

selection_process: Selection will be made through Personal Interview. Selection will be made strictly on the basis of qualifying marks
post qualification experience & performance in the interview
how_to_apply: Log in to the Company’s Website to download the application format.
Fill out the application in the prescribed format.
Enclose the Demand Draft for the applicable fee.
Enclose a set of self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates in proof of qualification, age, category, and experience.
Affix a passport size photograph at the provided space on the application form.
Pack the application in a sealed cover superscribed “Application for the post of -------------”.

Send the application through Ordinary post, Speed post, Register post, or Courier to the Manager & HOD (P&A), Instrumentation Limited, Kanjikode West, Palakkad-678 623 on or before 26.10.2026, 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: The recruitment is purely temporary in nature on a fixed tenure basis (initially for 2 years, extendable up to 2 years) and does not entitle candidates for regular employment. Candidates can apply for only one post clearly mentioning the post applied for. Applications received through Fax, E-mail, or By hand will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. An amount @ 5% will be deducted at source from monthly emoluments towards surety amount, which will be returned without interest upon successful completion of contract tenure. Selected candidates must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination at the Instrumentation Limited Dispensary. Candidates applying for technical positions with color blindness will not be considered. Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed III AC Train fare by the shortest route upon producing proof of travel. Applicants serving in Govt./Public Sector Enterprises must apply through proper channel or produce a ‘No Objection Certificate’ at the interview.

content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Limited Selection Process

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Instrumentation Limited
content_sections.text: Log in to the Company’s Website to download the application format. Fill out the application in the prescribed format. Enclose the Demand Draft for the applicable fee. Enclose a set of self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates in proof of qualification, age, category, and experience. Affix a passport size photograph at the provided space on the application form. Pack the application in a sealed cover superscribed “Application for the post of -------------”. Send the application through Ordinary post, Speed post, Register post, or Courier to the Manager & HOD (P&A), Instrumentation Limited, Kanjikode West, Palakkad-678 623 on or before 26.10.2026, 05:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form with passport-size photograph affixed Demand Draft (fee payment proof) Self-attested photocopies of qualification certificates and mark sheets Proof of age (Birth certificate/SSLC) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/PWD/Ex-Servicemen/Minority/EWS) issued by Competent Authority, if applicable Experience certificates No Objection Certificate (NOC) from employer, if serving in Govt./Public Sector Enterprises/Semi-Govt./Autonomous Organisations

content_sections.heading: Instrumentation Limited Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The recruitment is purely temporary in nature on a fixed tenure basis (initially for 2 years, extendable up to 2 years) and does not entitle candidates for regular employment. Candidates can apply for only one post clearly mentioning the post applied for. Applications received through Fax, E-mail, or By hand will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. An amount @ 5% will be deducted at source from monthly emoluments towards surety amount, which will be returned without interest upon successful completion of contract tenure. Selected candidates must undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination at the Instrumentation Limited Dispensary. Candidates applying for technical positions with color blindness will not be considered. Candidates attending the interview will be reimbursed III AC Train fare by the shortest route upon producing proof of travel. Applicants serving in Govt./Public Sector Enterprises must apply through proper channel or produce a ‘No Objection Certificate’ at the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is Instrumentation Limited Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification released by Instrumentation Limited to engage 4 experienced professionals as Sr. Engineers on Fixed Term Employment (FTE) at Palakkad.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for Sr. Engineer across Commercial (2), QC (1), and F&A (1) departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 26 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Sr. Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Commercial and QC posts require a BE/B.Tech (Mechanical) with first class, while F&A applicants require a B.Tech (IT/CS) or MCA with first class, along with relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 38 years as on 01.10.2026, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- for General, EWS, and OBC candidates, and Rs. 250/- for SC/ST candidates. PwD candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. How should I submit my application?
faq.answer: Applications must be filled in the prescribed format and sent by Ordinary post, Speed post, Register post, or Courier to the Manager & HOD (P&A), Instrumentation Limited, Kanjikode West, Palakkad-678 623.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this placement is purely on a Fixed Term Employment (FTE) basis for an initial period of 2 years, extendable up to a maximum of 4 years, and does not entitle candidates to permanent employment.
